# Inputs the conformance number leaves out, by name (TESTING.md, "Golden
# gate"; CONFORMANCE-GAPS.md "Corpus noise"). One `<set>/<relpath> <reason>`
# per line; `#` starts a comment. Each is a deck its own simulator is meant
# to reject, or one no SpiceRack reader reads, so a refusal on it says
# nothing about a writer.
#

# Xyce_Regression checks the error text, not a result).

# Xyce_Regression decks Xyce 7.10 `-norun` rejects (ZERO-LEDGER P1-022;
# the run: spicerack-golden/zp1-022-xyce-norun.tsv) for a class the reader
# cannot see from one line, so no P0010 is raised on them. A deck whose
# rejected line is one P0010's classes see is not here: the reader leaves
# that line out with P0010 (`render/read/rejects.rs`).

# Cross-file: the line is right; the file it reads is missing, broken, or
# a plugin Xyce was not given.

#
# One line, outside P0010's classes (`render/read/rejects.rs`): `.MEASURE`
# forms no rule sees yet (fewer than three words, a VAL with no `=`, a
# type Xyce has not, a PAR or a parenthesis with no quote inside, a bound
# that is a bare name, a RISE, FALL or CROSS that is no count, a bound
# that names another measure), and a misspelled `.SUBCKT` Xyce only warns
# about, so its instance names no subcircuit.
